name: DTXT liquidity-helper bonus and add-liquidity fee bypass
summary: DTXT's liquidity helper 0xd2453ff8 let any caller add USDT liquidity paired with the helper's own DTXT and then also sent the caller an equal DTXT bonus, without limit, and DTXT's _isLiquidity() treated any transfer into the pair as a fee-free liquidity add whenever the pair's USDT balance exceeded its reserve. With a flash loan the attacker harvested 359M DTXT from the helper via add and remove liquidity, then sent 1 wei of USDT to the pair and dumped the DTXT without the 50% sell fee for the pool's USDT.
notes: The helper is not attacker code (the PoC labels it a pre-funded seed helper): it is unverified, was created by DTXT's deployer 0xb009266e, was funded with 370.97M DTXT by DTXT's owner 0x1afb9cd5, and served ordinary users' small liquidity adds before the exploit. Both contracts carry part of the defect and were deployed 39 minutes apart.
Loss is the DTXT/USDT pair's net USDT outflow; the helper's DTXT has no price and is realised through that USDT (rule 12).
